ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) to 80-85% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) mottled blobs concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered, lower-density linear white pixel clusters distributed throughout the central and medial black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 105-degree V-shaped notch; depth is approximately 12-15% of the total visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-4 pixel) serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits higher-amplitude (10-15 pixel) irregular indentations and notches near the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward curve originating from the central notch and terminating at acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-contrast, unaligned white linear streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both lobes; distinct irregular notches and structural loss along the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
